verdict.rationale: Unleash's marketing claims you can kill features "in real time and without redeploys," and its docs say flags can be toggled without redeploying. Neither source documents how changes reach connected SDKs or how fast they arrive. Missing for 10: documented streaming or polling delivery to SDKs, stated propagation latency or refresh intervals, details of how Edge passes updates to SDKs, and independent or hands-on proof that a kill switch takes effect within seconds.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
